S.FORM: == kakiliman == Nuw-luw bayduk 諾羅病毒 Nuw-luw-bayduk "kamu nu Ing, norovirus, saadidi' a sulit, NV" singangan aca tu nuw-luw-bayduk, tu singangan tu nu-wa-ke bayduk "Norwalk virus", uyza i kasienawan mikeliday tu cilkay kacakenuhan bayduk nu bituka sawada' a adada. 諾羅病毒(英語:norovirus,縮寫:NV) (Norwalk virus), . nilaculan Nuw-luw bayduk a katinengan u milaliday tu tademaw atu cayay kakapah ku wen-sen nu hekal, mahiniay balunga, adidi'ay a picudadan atu pikanan. zuma tulu lima a dimiad ku imelang susud tanektek tu, maselep ku nikalalid. nika tuuday a nikelad a bayduk taneng mauzip tu tusa tulu a lipa, malaliday nu nanum a bayduk taneng tanayu' ku nikauzip. Nuw-luw bayduk adidi' ku kibetul "hakay 100 kayadah" ataneng imelang, angangan makayza menah milalid, sibaydukay a kakanan u tai' atu malalid nu uta', i katuuday a tademaw hakay makay uhuh, nibasingan amalalid. 968 a mihcaan i Amilik teban a satipan sakuwan E-hay-cow a Nuw-wa-ke naninang sa adada ku sawada', makay nikinsaan tu tai' nu imelangay a bayduk, pangangan han tu nu-wa-ke bayduk "NorwiIK virus" han. 1972 a mihcaan makaawas tu nu dingkiay a sapiazih mitapal maazih ku adidi'ay a masamulmulay, hinisa a u baydukn sa "Small Round Structured Virus: SRSV" tu zumaay. zikuz, makay cilekay macakenuhay ku adada nu sawada' adadaay makakitikitinay maazih ku Nu-wo-ke bayduk misengi tu adidi'ay a masamuluay a bayduk, pangangan han "lye-Nu-wo-ke bayduk" "Norwalk-like viruses" anca adidi'ay bayduk. 1972 "(Norwalk-like viruses)或小圓結構病毒. angangan adada nu Nuw-luw bayduk 諾羅病毒主要症狀 uyza a imelang angangan adada ku bili, mabanic, mauta' akuti' adada ku uziuzipan. pihaceng ku kabanic, mahuming, mabulilak a imelang apuyu ku kaimelang, 12 katuh 60 tatukian lawpes satu, nika pihaymaw tu nipatahkal a bayduk alalid sa 2 a lalipayan, piazih tu amisadimel. kalalidan 傳播途徑 Nuw-wu-ke bayduk icelang amilalid, mihmihcaan amilalid, sangaleh kasienawan ku yadahay. angangan a Kalalid siledek ku kakanen atu malalid ku mituka sawada'. M isimanta tu bayuay a tuku atu piya' nanumay a aadupen uyni a bayduk angangan malalid, amakayza siadadaay tu bituka sawada' a cilekay niuta'an atu tai', anca zikuz maacak nikaawas tu anabuh a malalid. uyni a baydukan taneng mauzip i hekal nu uzip tu tulu a lipayan katenes, matenes ku pitiyung caay piazih tu pilalidan. mahiniay imelangay mamin mutai' atu muuta' zikuz caay pisakapah mibanaw tu lima, mauning ku sazikec a panan nu luma' pisisilan nu nanum, sapibuhat tu tilibi, sasumin, zikuc, kapahay a uzip namitiyung tuynian a tuud hanulima sa miala sa mukan, anca nipahalhalan a kakanen, amalalid. imelangay a ngangan sibayduk tu, amana pulungen ku sakakaan atu kakaen .
